description: This file defines a Lua module implementing a filter for handling the 'X-Sendfile' header in the Lighttpd web server. It includes a class 'XFilterDrop' to drop content, functions to add the filter, and a handler function 'handle_x_sendfile' to process requests with the 'X-Sendfile' header, serving specified files.

classes.name: XFilterDrop
classes.description: A filter class that drops all input content and closes the input stream.

methods.name: XFilterDrop:new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new XFilterDrop instance.

methods.name: XFilterDrop:handle
methods.description: Handles the input by dropping all content and closing the input stream.
